case.summary: Card C13487-K1 processed flagged online transaction 3478561 for $74.96 on 2016-11-22 16:11:00 as part of a 3-transaction, $142.00 velocity burst over 48 hours. The investigation concluded with a verdict of fraud at a fraud probability of 0.97. The evidence rests on graph analysis showing 20 distinct cards reaching a new device profile via an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS) within 30 days, placing the card inside a 54-card connected component alongside 5 similar closed cases of confirmed fraud. The precise mechanism remains uncertain, as the coordinated abuse follows an undocumented pattern matching no known typology, and the $74.96 transaction amount itself falls within the card's historical spending range.
